$description: Web experience density. Emitted as CSS variables in generated web.css.

typography.$description: Chrome typography roles (visual-language.md 'Typography hierarchy'). A role names the text's job, not the component it appears in — which is what lets the same job be one value instead of one value per component. A role owns SIZE only: family (mono vs sans) and weight are orthogonal, and the evidence says so — `font-medium` appears under every role, and mono is used for both metadata and primary. Line-height stays with the block that owns it (`workspace.treeLineHeight`), not with the size role.

primary.$description: Work / local primary — highest within its region. Session name, active file, focused input.

secondary.$description: Supporting but fully readable. Section headings, tree rows.

metadata.$description: Quiet. Agent/location, recency, status details — never outweighs the thing it describes.

code.$description: Workload-specific. Code, paths, commands. The terminal keeps its own glyph rendering; this is the chrome-side code surface.

sidebarWidth.$description: Expanded sidebar column. The mockup draws 246px; the shell's grid is `246px 1fr`.

sessionRowPadY.$description: Session row vertical padding. The mockup draws 7px, tighter than `shell.space-2` (8px) because the row's two lines already carry leading; horizontal padding is `shell.space-2`.

sessionRowRadius.$description: Sidebar list row corner radius, shared by session rows and agent/node rows. The mockup rounds the row so the selected `--n-raised` fill reads as a chip rather than a band.

nodeRowPadY.$description: Agent/node row vertical padding. The mockup draws 6px — tighter than a session row's 7px, because a node row carries one line where a session row carries two.

nodeFontSize.$description: Agent/node row text. Monospace at 11.5px: a node name is infrastructure identity, and `visual-language.md` gives monospace the code/host identity role rather than using it as decoration.

sessionRowTitleFontSize.$description: Session name — the sidebar's primary role. The mockup's 12.5px, a half step below `text-sm` so two lines plus padding fit the row.

sessionRowMetaFontSize.$description: Session metadata (agent / recency) — the metadata role. Monospace and a full step below the title, so the title leads and the metadata never outweighs the thing it describes (visual-language.md typography rules).

footPadY.$description: Sidebar foot vertical padding. The mockup draws 9px; horizontal is `shell.space-3` (12px), which is what the mockup draws too.

footGap.$description: Sidebar foot gap between the status dot, its text and the controls.

statusDotSize.$description: The sidebar's status mark, shared by the foot's service dot, the collapsed rail's and the agent/node rows — one object in three places. Small on purpose: the mockup's comment on the foot is 'Healthy stays quiet; degraded may gain emphasis', so a steady state is a 5px mark beside quiet text rather than a badge.

footFontSize.$description: Sidebar foot text. Monospace, matching the session metadata it sits under.

sectionHeadFontSize.$description: Sidebar section label (Agents / Sessions) — the secondary role. Muted and below `text-xs`, so a section label never competes with the rows it names. Top padding is `shell.space-1` (4px) and the sides `shell.space-2` (8px), which is what the mockup draws.

sectionHeadPadBottom.$description: Sidebar section label bottom padding. The mockup draws 7px, tighter than the sides so the label sits with the rows it names rather than floating between sections.

sectionSepMargin.$description: Inset separator between sidebar sections. The mockup draws `margin: 8px`, so the rule does not run edge to edge — it reads as a division inside the column, not as another panel edge.

dockTarget.$description: Web dock targets: pointer input, so the control-md band applies.

workspace.$description: Web Workspace master/detail. The mockup draws the tree at a fixed 208px — a navigation column sized to its content, not a fraction of the pane — with the editor taking the rest.

treeFontSize.$description: Tree text — the secondary role. Monospace: a path is workload identity, and the mockup sets the whole tree in mono rather than only the filenames.

treeLineHeight.$description: Tree line box. Looser than the text size implies, which is what lets the row's own vertical padding stay at 1px and still scan as a list.

treeRowPadY.$description: Tree row vertical padding. 1px, because `lineHeight: 1.85` already carries the row's breathing room — padding and leading together would double it.

treeIndentStep.$description: Indent per tree depth. The mockup's levels are 20/33/46px from a 7px row inset, i.e. 13px a step.

editorFontSize.$description: The code surface — the code role. Terminal glyph rendering stays with the terminal; this is chrome-side code text.

editorLineHeight.$description: Code line box. The mockup's 1.75, looser than the tree's 1.85 ratio at a larger size — line numbers have to line up with their line.

editorGutterWidth.$description: Line-number column. Fixed so numbers align regardless of digit count.

editorPadY.$description: Code surface vertical padding. The mockup's 14px, top and bottom, so the first line is not flush against the header.

editorGutterPadEnd.$description: Space between the line numbers and the code. The mockup's 14px — wide enough that a number and the first glyph do not read as one token.

editorHeadFontSize.$description: The file path above the code. Muted and below `text-xs`: it names what is open, it is not a title competing with the work.

editorHeadPadX.$description: Header horizontal inset. The mockup's 18px, which is wider than the shell's `space-4` — the header is inside the code surface, so it aligns to the code's own measure rather than to the pane's chrome padding.
